verdict.rationale: YPOG's own materials touch on related ground: a GmbH/UG foundation starter kit and questionnaire, a webinar on the particularities of German cap tables, and briefings on the tax treatment of equity participation (§19a GITA, dry-income taxation). These target employee ESOPs and general formation, not founder equity mechanics specifically. Missing for 10: any material on founder vesting or reverse-vesting schedules, a founder-level equivalent of the 83(b) election, guidance on co-founder equity splits, and independent corroboration.
